interface.shortDescription: Sol coordinated, Luna delegated evidence-first workflows for serious codebase work.
interface.longDescription: Fable-5 for Codex provides skills for audits, deep reviews, fact checks, codebase understanding, design options, and repo-wide sweeps. Demanding runs keep GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra as the coordinator and use GPT-5.6 Luna medium for bounded subagents by default. Each workflow emphasizes ECF-style run contracts, source-grounded mapping, independent lenses, verified findings, rejected-candidate preservation, coverage notes, explicit unknowns, and honest Workflow Traces.
defaultPrompt: Use $fable-audit with a Sol Ultra coordinator, Luna medium workers, and an ECF run contract on this repo.
Use $fable-understand with an ECF run contract to explain boot flow.
